# Lanesra OS

Lanesra OS is a modern, open-source sales and business management application for small businesses.

## Current status

- Early Access v0.12.0
- Browser-based live demo is available
- Windows desktop edition is in early development: the source is public today (Tauri + Rust + SQLite) with the full sales lifecycle, Contracts, Tasks, user management, Team Workspace mode for small teams (Docker), backup/restore, self-service password change, PDF generation and printing, and CSV import/export all working. An unsigned Early Access Windows installer (.exe/.msi) is available from GitHub Releases; build and run from source is also supported.
- Also shipped: an admin-configurable layer on top of the fixed schema - branding and print customization, reports beyond the dashboard (revenue, win rate, AR aging, sales by owner), custom fields on Companies and Contacts, conditional business rules over those fields, and workflow automation that auto-creates follow-up tasks on Opportunity/Invoice status changes.
- Next up: a code-signed installer and task reminder notifications.

## Core capabilities

- Companies and contacts
- Opportunities and sales pipeline
- Products and services
- Quotes, orders and invoices
- Contracts
- Tasks and activities
- Sales dashboards
- Connected relationship validation
- Automatic record numbering

## Product principles

- User ownership of business data
- Offline-first desktop direction
- Connected records instead of duplicated free text
- Simplicity before feature volume
- Open-source transparency
- Modern, accessible product design
